name: Dropdown navigation
definition: Top navigation where an item opens a short list of sub-pages on click or keyboard, and closes on Escape or outside click.
bestUse: Sites with a handful of sections that each have two to six pages.

demo.how: The Product and Resources items are buttons that open a short list of sub-pages under the bar. Click one or press Enter on it, use Tab through the links, and press Escape or click elsewhere to close. Only one menu is open at a time, and the open button is marked expanded.
